summary: Data-driven dialect registry. DialectSpec (frozen dataclass) holds per-dialect config: ibis_backend_name, connection_mode, connection_string_scheme, connection_builder, and optional hook callables for index/upsert/rename. DIALECTS dict maps 23 dialect names to their specs. Private _build_* functions construct ibis connections per-dialect.
extension_points: Add a new entry to DIALECTS dict + a _build_* connection builder to support a new SQL engine
lifecycle_notes: 23 dialects: sqlite, duckdb, motherduck, postgres, mysql, mssql, oracle, snowflake, bigquery, redshift, trino, clickhouse, databricks, singlestoredb, exasol, impala, materialize, risingwave, druid, pyspark
documentation_hooks: Extension authors add dialects here — each is a two-line DialectSpec + a builder function

evidence.detail: DIALECTS dict with 23 entries, DialectSpec dataclass
